answer_1.quote: we investigate what information helps an LLM in locating the first error step in a math problem solution... we explore an alternative approach that generates an intermediate corrected version of the student's solution
answer_1.outputs: corrected student solutions and error step predictions

answer_2.quote: We also use this quantity (Semantic Recall) as a feature for further analysis in §4.2... BERTScore recall

answer_4.quote: We conducted a two-person annotation where both annotators hold at least a masters degree in a STEM field
answer_4.guideline: • Correctness: Is the LLM-generated correction factually and mathematically sound at each step and does it arrive at the correct answer? (Yes/No) • Stylistic Similarity: Is the LLM-generated correction, stylistically and in approach, similar to the student's solution up to the first error step? (Yes/No)
